# Git and GitHub Practical

## Context
I used Git and GitHub to manage a small project containing example RNA-seq sample metadata. The aim was to learn how version control helps track changes and organise bioinformatics work.

## My Contribution
I created a repository, recorded changes with commits, and pushed my work to GitHub. I also worked with branches, merged a pull request, resolved a merge conflict, and configured .gitignore to exclude example pipeline outputs.

## Outcome
This practical gave me introductory experience with a Git workflow that I can apply to future coding projects. I learned how to inspect changes, maintain a clear project history, and manage conflicting edits without losing track of earlier work.

[View my practice repository](https://github.com/JStringer13/AI_For_Programming)
